newsitem.title: USA: U.S. FERC sets PJM pricing conference for May 9.
newsitem.headline: U.S. FERC sets PJM pricing conference for May 9.

text.p: The U.S. Federal Energy Regulatory Commission said Thursday it would hold a conference May 9 to resolve problems in a transmission pricing proposal for the Pennsylvania-New Jersey-Maryland (PJM) Power Pool.

The commission called for a conference in a ruling in February on two rival PJM transmission plans, in which it questioned what would be the fairest prices for transmission during periods of congestion on the pool's system.

One plan was proposed by the Supporting Companies Group, made up of all PJM utility members except PECO Energy Co, which called for users to pay congestion fees on specific paths on which their power moves.
The other plan, proposed by PECO, called for congestion charges to be incorporated into a single fee for all PJM pool users.
